x: Following his illustrious predecessors Tommy Green and Norman Guilmant Pat Duncan became the third Belgravian to win this race and the first man to beat eight hours for the trip.

Belgrave have their share of heroes Tommy Green four times winner, Norman Guilmant won it, L.C.Allen and Harry Shields won the veteran's award, Ray Hall one of six men who have bettered the magical eight hour barrier and George Beecham holder of more winning team medals than any other man.

Belgrave hopes rose for the first Belgrave man to win this race since 1954 when Norman Guilmant took the title. Moullin was now moving very well and although our 3rd and 4th men were surrounded by hostile forces their experience could be relied upon in the later stages.

The following year Norman Guilmant took Belgrave's first individual medal since 1937 when he finished 2nd. In 1954 the Club rounded off a triumphant season by taking both individual and team honours in the 'Brighton'.
